critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_policy (~L2315): @api.api_route('/public/policies/{slot}', methods=['GET','HEAD']) — correctly supports both verbs via one handler. FastAPI's FileResponse handles HEAD semantics automatically (body suppressed, headers preserved). Confirmed via curl: HEAD=200 CT=application/pdf CL=1510324. This is the exact root-cause fix for the 'iframe only renders after download' bug: the frontend HEAD probe (r.ok check) now succeeds before GET. ✓

server.py me_ai_summarize (~L2607): clean dual-provider pattern mirroring the existing Whisper approach. Provider defaults to 'openai' when null/unknown, so new deployments don't silently break. 45s timeout for OpenAI, 60s for n8n — reasonable. Error wrapping: 502 for 4xx/5xx from upstream with the API's error message extracted, 504 for timeouts, 500 with stringified exception (capped 300 chars) as last resort. ✓

server.py me_ai_summarize auth forwarding (~L2672): auth_type='bearer' adds Authorization header; 'basic' uses httpx tuple auth=(user,pass); 'none' sends no creds. Only forwards when both fields populated — prevents sending empty headers. ✓

server.py me_ai_summarize n8n response parsing (~L2708): accepts 4 shapes (summary/text/output/message), falls back to first-element of list, then to stringified JSON capped at 2000 chars. Robust for n8n's variable workflow output. Verified with httpbin echo returning arbitrary shape → ok=True, summary populated. ✓

server.py admin settings masking (~L4383): SECRET_FIELDS tuple extended with openai_chat_api_key, n8n_webhook_token, n8n_webhook_basic_pass. The '********' placeholder detection in admin_update_settings (~L4403) prevents accidental secret overwriting when admin UI roundtrips the masked value. ✓

models.py SettingsUpdate (~L449): 8 new optional str fields with proper docstring comments specifying valid enum values ('openai'|'n8n', 'none'|'bearer'|'basic'). Pydantic validation still handled at endpoint level (.lower() normalization). ✓

AdminSettings.jsx (~L396-470): new 'Synthèse IA (ChatGPT ou n8n / AgentAI)' section with provider selector, OpenAI block (key + model), n8n block (url + auth_type); conditional reveal of bearer token input (auth_type=bearer) and basic user/pass pair (auth_type=basic). Matches review spec. ✓

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter20 suite = /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter20.py (9 tests, ~5s). Two upstream dependencies that MAY flake: (a) OpenAI 401 test hits https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions — if the sandbox loses egress, it will time out and our endpoint returns 504 (test accepts either 502 or 504). (b) n8n echo test hits https://httpbin.org/anything — if httpbin is down, test skips with a clear message. Both are defensive. Mocking via monkeypatch on server.httpx.AsyncClient.post is NOT done because the backend runs in a separate supervisor process; we validate via real upstreams + controlled inputs instead. If a future iter wants pure unit mocking, factor the two HTTP calls into small helper functions (_call_openai_chat(body,key,model), _call_n8n(url,body,auth_type,token,user,pass)) and monkeypatch those in-process. Pytest invocation: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter20.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_iter20.xml`. Preview URL was asleep during frontend Playwright attempt — suggest retrying UI automation after waking the preview.
rca of the issue: Two items verified: (1) 'iframe preview only works after download' bug — root cause was @api.get('/public/policies/{slot}') which registers GET only; the frontend iframe component did a HEAD probe (r.ok) before setting src, and FastAPI answered HEAD with 405 Method Not Allowed so r.ok=false and the error-state branch hid the iframe. Fix: switched to @api.api_route('/public/policies/{slot}', methods=['GET','HEAD']) — FastAPI/Starlette now handles HEAD via the same handler, suppressing the body while preserving Content-Type + Content-Length. Verified: curl -I returns 200 CT=application/pdf CL=1510324 (vs 405 before). (2) New /api/me/ai/summarize is cleanly gated by provider config — 503 when unconfigured, 502 with upstream message when OpenAI/n8n reject, 504 on timeout. Auth-header forwarding works for both bearer and basic on n8n. Masking is enforced consistently with existing secrets pattern.
